comparison_command: $source = Get-Content -LiteralPath artifacts/server1/K01/K01-A/comparison/source.raw.txt; $candidate = Get-Content -LiteralPath artifacts/server1/K01/K01-A/comparison/candidate.raw.txt; $diff = Compare-Object -ReferenceObject $source -DifferenceObject $candidate; if ($null -eq $diff) { 'COMPARE-OBJECT: no differences'; exit 0 }; $diff | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String; exit 1

M814 virtual-piece threshold and verification/virtual/wire geometry
